name: Global activity (PMI)
summary: Global composite PMI 53.2 in October; November flashes eased in the US (54.6) and UK (52.3), euro area steady at 51.7
state: The J.P.Morgan Global Composite PMI fell to 53.2 in October from 54.3, its first decline in seven months (S&P Global, 5 Nov). November flash PMIs on 23 Nov showed slower growth: the US composite fell to a four-month low of 54.6 from 55.9 (Newsquawk), the UK composite eased to 52.3 from 52.9 (ActionForex) and the euro area held at 51.7. All remain above 50, so the global reading looks set to stay above the 51 Watch line; the November global figure is due in early December.
for_you: Global business activity is still expanding, though growth is cooling in the US and UK. Firms report steady demand overall.
rubric_hit: Global composite 53.2 > 51 Normal line (Oct); Nov flashes all > 50
